anomalies.description: A head-on collision occurs between the dashcam vehicle and an oncoming truck on a narrow rural road, resulting in immediate impact and windshield shattering.
A snowplow and a semi-truck collide head-on or at an angle on a snowy highway, causing the semi-truck to jackknife and slide across the road, narrowly missing the dashcam vehicle.

A large semi-truck makes an extremely wide left turn, encroaching heavily into the oncoming lane and passing perilously close to a stationary white sedan directly ahead of the dashcam vehicle. The trailer's side scrapes or nearly contacts the sedan’s rear/side, constituting a near-miss or minor collision event.
Vehicle loses control on a rural road, veers off the road, and collides with a tree or object, resulting in violent camera rotation and impact with a red vehicle (likely a Kamaz truck).
A motorcycle is struck by a bus at an intersection, causing it to fall and slide across the road surface.
